_doc: Static file inventory. Distinct from layers because some files back multiple layer views (e.g. <chrom>.json backs ~50 logical layers). The shell uses this for: precaching, integrity checks, packaging (build/package_workflow.py), and dev-tools file listings.

chrom_main._doc: The big per-chromosome JSON. Backs the scrubber_main layer.

chrom_band_pipeline_outputs._doc: SPEC BLOCK 1 R-module outputs. Lazy-loaded via state_io.loadPrecompTsv() in legacy.

candidate_dir._layout: data/candidates/{candidate_id}/lineage.json (the version index, one per candidate) + data/candidates/{candidate_id}/{version_id}/<aspect>.json (one folder per version, containing all version-scoped aspects).
candidate_dir._doc: writable: true — browser-side analysis modules write per-candidate JSONs via Registry.write. HPC-side producers also write here directly. Server path allowlist requires data/candidates/{cid}/lineage.json OR data/candidates/{cid}/{version_id}/<aspect>.json.

review_session_writes._doc: WRITE set for the inversion review workflow. Browser cannot write filesystem directly — these are JSON-blob downloads the user re-uploads.

arrangement_calls_session._doc: Output of the band_tracking arrangement-call pipeline. Per SPEC_arrangement_color_mode_and_arrangement_calls_v1.md. version_id required — arrangement is tied to which boundary version it was derived against. writable: true — browser-side band_tracking can write here via Registry.write.

server_results_cache._doc: Server compute results, cached to disk via the persist hook. When a layer entry has persist: true, every successful operation result is written here under op_id/hash(args).json. The actual disk root is configured via popstats_server.config.yaml > server_results_cache_root (default /mnt/e/inversion-atlas-cache/server_results/). The path template here is the LOGICAL path used by the registry; the server rewrites the _cache/server_results/ prefix to the configured filesystem root.
server_results_cache._excluded_from_tarballs: By convention this directory is excluded from project tarballs and gitignored. Sits on the user's big disk so test runs don't bloat the source tree.
